description:
Is this Illinois professional (or licensed firm) licensed, and is the license active, expired or disciplined? From the state regulator's (IDFPR) public file. Use it only to verify a professional or vendor you contract with or are about to contract with. Not for employment screening of individuals, not for marketing or recruiting lists, not for profiling a person, and not for any decision covered by the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
Inputs: license_number, OR name (full name, or a firm's exact name) plus profession (for example nurse, real estate broker, CPA, roofing contractor). Optional city and zip only help choose between people with the same name. No partial names, no wildcards, no lists.
Price: $0.02 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call coverage first (free): it lists every license kind covered.
Verdicts:
- active: A license was found and the state lists it as active, with no public discipline on record.
- expired: A license was found, but it has expired or was not renewed.
- inactive_or_revoked: A license was found, but it is not in force (inactive, cancelled, suspended, revoked, terminated or similar).
- disciplined: A license was found and the state has public discipline on record for it. The license may still be active: read license_active and status. The discipline block gives the most recent action's category and date, then every action's category and dates; the state's lookup page has the record.
- possible_match: More than one license fits the name and profession, or one fits but its city or ZIP does not agree with the one you sent (flag location_not_matched). candidates lists each one's profession, city and license number: check again with the license number.
- not_found: No license fits. This does not prove the person is unlicensed: see not_found_note.
Returned for a match: the name as the state shows it, profession, license type and number, status, license_active, original issue and expiration dates, city and state, and whether public discipline is on record. Never a street address, ZIP, birth date, phone or e-mail. not_found does not prove a person is unlicensed. Not covered: professions IDFPR does not license (for example general contractors, electricians, plumbers, attorneys, insurance agents and teachers), controlled-substance licenses, security-guard registrations and firearm cards. A name must match the state's record: try the license number.
Example call: {"name":"Jane Q. Sample","profession":"registered nurse","city":"Joliet"}
Example response: {"verdict":"active","match":{"licensee_name":"JANE Q SAMPLE","profession":"REGISTERED PROFESSIONAL NURSE","license_type":"NURSING BOARD","license_number":"041000000","status":"ACTIVE","license_active":true,"original_issue_date":"2012-06-01","expiration_date":"2028-05-31","city":"JOLIET","state":"IL","discipline_on_record":false,"discipline":null},"candidates":[],"matched_on":"name_profession_and_city","source":{"attribution":"Contains information from the IDFPR Professional Licensing database, which is made available by the State of Illinois under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0."},"data_as_of":"2026-11-27"}

city.description: Optional city, max 100 characters. Used only to choose between people with the same name.

license_number.description: The Illinois license number, for example 041123456 (dots and spaces are ignored). Send this, or name plus profession.

name.description: The licensee's full name (first and last name), or a licensed firm's exact name. 3 to 120 characters. No partial names or wildcards.

profession.description: Required with name: the profession or license kind, for example nurse, real estate broker, CPA, roofing contractor. The coverage tool lists every kind.

zip.description: Optional ZIP code, 5 digits or ZIP+4. Used only to choose between people with the same name; never returned.

name: verify_license
title: Verify an Illinois professional license
